contract.claim_65.value: We claim u(23) = 65 only with an exact embedding of a 23-vertex, 65-edge graph accepted by the checker.

contract.claim_64.value: We claim u(23) = 64 only when the enumeration of Section 2 is complete for the graphs that could exist, every graph at its top level carries a checker-accepted refutation (or a TU witness), and gates G0 to G6 are green.

contract.never.value: Never "u(23) = 64" on an empty level whose emptiness was not produced by the certified pipeline, on numerics, or on an unchecked certificate. Never hide a dependency: the claim rests on u(22) = 60, on AMP's u(n) for n <= 21, on the 398 minimal forbidden graphs (Globus-Parshall and GP-10), and on the six TU gadgets.

contract.intro.value: u(n) is the maximum number of edges of a unit-distance graph on n vertices (OEIS A186705). Known before this programme: u(23) >= 64 (AMP, arXiv:2412.11914, Theorem 1(b): configurations found by Engel et al. and AMP), and u(22) = 60 (our u(22) result). AMP's Lemma (Schade): a graph with n vertices and m edges has an induced subgraph on n - 1 vertices with at least ceil(m(n-2)/n) edges. With m = 66 that subgraph would have 61 > u(22) edges, so **u(23) <= 65, and u(23) is 64 or 65.**

value: **Minimum degree exactly 5.** Deleting a vertex of degree d leaves a unit-distance graph with 65 - d <= u(22) = 60 edges, so d >= 5; and 2 x 65 / 23 < 6, so some vertex has degree <= 5. (Schade's bound; no extra lemma needed.)

**Free of all 398.** It contains none of the 398 minimal forbidden graphs on at most 10 vertices (`research/unit-distance-22/data/forbidden-398.json`, sha256 pinned in Section 5): each is not a unit-distance graph, and subgraphs of unit-distance graphs are unit-distance graphs.
**TU-free, hereditarily.** PRUNING.md's Lemma L2 with (N, M) = (23, 65): a TU gadget with its pair non-adjacent in an induced subgraph would force a 66th unit distance, and u(23) <= 65.
**Every canonical ancestor is a unit-distance graph** (L1), so the ancestor on j vertices has at most u(j) edges: u(j) from AMP for j <= 21, and u(22) = 60.

contract.section3.value: Every graph written at (23, 65) and not TU-pruned is either embedded exactly (then u(23) = 65 and the programme stops to verify it three ways) or refuted by a certificate that `research/gp-10/check/gp10check.py`'s sample profile (or `research/unit-distance-22/check/udcheck.py`) accepts. Unknown is never absorbed into a claim.

contract.amend2_deps.value: Section 0's dependencies gain Lemma R (every unit 4-cycle of an injective embedding is a rhombus; Globus-Parshall's Lemma 2) and Lemma T (every unit triangle is rotated by +-60 degrees).
